**Direct answer:** Global semiconductor sales hit a record in 2024. The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) first reported $627.6 billion, up 19.1% from $526.8 billion in 2023. WSTS (the World Semiconductor Trade Statistics body, which supplies SIA's data) later revised the final 2024 total to $630.5 billion. This was the first year above $600 billion. I used four of my eight retrievals.

**Claims and sources**

- SIA announced 2024 sales of $627.6B on Feb 7, 2025, up 19.1% from $526.8B in 2023. https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- That was the first time annual sales exceeded $600B. https://x.com/SIAAmerica/status/1887958734183219214 and https://www.trendforce.com/news/2025/02/08/news-global-semiconductor-sales-hit-record-high-at-600b-in-2024-set-for-double-digit-growth-in-2025/
- SIA's page says WSTS later updated the 2024 year-end total to $630.5B. It doesn't give a growth rate for the revised figure. https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- The 2025 SIA Factbook also gives $630.5B. https://www.semiconductors.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2025-SIA-Factbook-FINAL-1.pdf
- The SIA figures are WSTS monthly data, compiled as three-month moving averages. https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- Growth by region in 2024 was very uneven:
  - Americas: +44.8%
  - China: +18.3%
  - Asia Pacific/All Others: +12.5%
  - Japan: −0.4%
  - Europe: −8.1%

  https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- Memory rose 78.9% to $165.1B (DRAM +82.6%), and logic was the largest category at $212.6B. SIA credited AI demand. These figures came from a search summary of SIA's release, not a page I read. https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- The forecasts for 2024 and later years were different numbers, and they moved over time:
  - Spring 2024 WSTS forecast for 2024: +16.0%.
  - Fall 2024 WSTS forecast for 2024: +19.0%, about $627B.
  - Spring 2025 WSTS forecast for 2025: +11.2%, to $700.9B.
  - Spring 2025 WSTS forecast for 2026: $760.7B.
  - Later 2025 revisions: +15.4% (August 2025) and then +22.5%, to $772.2B (December 2025).

  Sources: https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/esrapdf/generate/12151, https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/esrapdf/generate/12461, https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf, https://www.eusemiconductors.eu/sites/default/files/ESIA_WSTS_PR_AuFc2025.pdf

**How to tell them apart**

- **Finalized annual figure:** This is realized, global sales for the full year, reported by SIA/WSTS as an actual. Several versions exist, so cite the one you use. The figure is $627.6B in the February 2025 release and $630.5B in the later WSTS-updated total. The 19.1% growth rate belongs to the first figure only.
- **Forecast:** WSTS and SIA publish forecasts for later periods, and those numbers are revised each spring and fall. A 2024 forecast such as 16.0% or 19.0% isn't the 2024 result, and the 2025 and 2026 figures haven't been finalized.
- **Regional growth rate:** This applies to one region only. Europe fell 8.1% while the Americas rose 44.8%, and neither is the global growth rate.

**What I couldn't establish**

- A 19.7% growth figure for 2024 came up in my search and I couldn't confirm it. I couldn't read the Spring 2025 WSTS PDF, because it returned as unreadable binary. So I can't give a verified growth rate for the revised $630.5B total. Dividing $630.5B by $526.8B gives about 19.7%, but that assumes 2023 wasn't also revised.
- I didn't verify a Wikipedia claim that 2025 sales reached $791.7B.
